name: your-sity-publication-isolation
install_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /workspace/your-sity
npm ci --cache /workspace/.npm-cache --no-audit --no-fund
npm run lint
npm run typecheck
npm run build
start_skill:
Use the existing isolated checkout at /workspace/your-sity; do not create a Git worktree unless explicitly requested. Read AGENTS.md and docs/progress.md first. Validated runtime: Node.js 24.22.1 and npm 11.9.0 (project requires Node 22+). Dependencies and build outputs may survive the snapshot; processes do not. If dependencies are missing run npm ci --cache /workspace/.npm-cache --no-audit --no-fund.

Validation must run before starting a persistent development server: npm run lint; npm run typecheck; npm run build; PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH=/usr/bin/chromium npm test. Preserve each command's exit status and stop on failure. Tests start and stop their own server on port 3100. Next.js permits only one dev server per checkout: if a server is already running, identify it and stop only a server you started; do not delete lock files or kill unrelated processes. The validated system browser is /usr/bin/chromium. If absent, use a verified installed browser via PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH or install Playwright Chromium through approved network settings; do not bypass TLS verification.

Start the application from /workspace/your-sity with npm run dev -- --port 3000 and retain the process. Verify curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/feed succeeds, then use a browser to wait for .shell[aria-busy=false], confirm three demo posts, select My Communities and confirm two posts. A PID or open port alone is not readiness. Restart the development server in each new task. No Supabase credentials are needed for the milestones 1–2 demo; real authentication and publishing are intentionally disabled. Never commit secrets. Environment publication is a separate user-facing action: a successful install, draft save or running dev server does not confirm snapshot publication. Milestone 3 must remain on hold until the publication issue is resolved.
note: Preparation worksheet only, not an imported or created environment. Create separately via supported UI; retain existing environment. Source and setup validated in prior clean-source experiment; alternative snapshot/publication remains untested.
